Announcements
We have mailed the 2026 Form AWC -Alternative Withholding Certificate- to all
non-Minnesota residents . By signing Form AWC and returning it to us, you will alleviate
the company from withholding on your behalf. Please contact us if you have any
questions or have not received your form by November 1, 2026;
Please return the signed form by December 4, 2026.
GFE Board of Governors Nominee Questionnaire
Granite Falls Energy, LLC (the “Company”) is preparing for its March 2027
annual members meeting and the Governor elections that will take place at that meeting.
The purpose of the questionnaire is to obtain information from potential
Governor nominees so the Company’s nominating committee is able to
recommend nominees for election to the Board.
*Submission Deadline November 1, 2026*

co-products throughout the United States and international markets.
